cosmetic: The fourth conversation row at the bottom of the sidebar list is cut off halfway at the edge of the scroll area, so its text can't be read. It's normal scroll overflow, and the 'Some native sessions are unavailable' row below it is still readable.
Conversation titles in the sidebar are cut off with ellipses (e.g. 'Exercise external activity…', 'Exercise composer choic…'). This is expected truncation.
Two 'Retry' buttons are visible: one on the user message bubble and one under the blocked banner. Having both may be confusing.
'Retry' and 'Try automatic again' are stacked on separate rows instead of sitting side by side, which leaves a lot of empty space.
The blocked notice uses a red, error-style banner, while the 'Blocked' status badge is amber. The colours don't match for what is a wait state.
